definitions: Industrial formulations, typically containing five or more ingredients, often including additives like emulsifiers, thickeners, and artificial flavors, and high in sugar, unhealthy fats, and salt, designed for convenience and palatability.
Food products that have undergone extensive industrial processing, often involving the addition of substances not commonly used in home cooking, and are typically ready-to-eat or ready-to-heat.
examples: Consumption of ultra-processed foods is linked to various health issues.
Many breakfast cereals are considered ultra-processed foods.
Reducing intake of ultra-processed foods can improve diet quality.
